meta.title: SakanHubb — Smart real-estate platform
meta.description: A Saudi real-estate platform for daily rentals, sales, and long-term leases. Transparent pricing, instant booking, verified hosts.

hero.title: Book, list, and manage properties — in one place.
hero.subtitle: SakanHubb connects renters, owners, offices, and marketers with full transparency and per-halalah accuracy.

features.title: A complete platform, built for Saudi Arabia

items.title: Full financial transparency
items.body: Every riyal shown: fees, VAT, host share, and total — no surprises.

items.title: REGA + PDPL aligned
items.body: Architecture aligned with real-estate advertising rules and personal-data protection.

items.title: Double-entry ledger
items.body: Immutable book, reliable settlements, safe refunds — every party's rights preserved.

items.title: Augmented reality
items.body: See a property in place through your phone camera before you book.

items.title: Secure OTP sign-in
items.body: No passwords, no card data on-device. Payments run through licensed providers.

items.title: Multiple roles
items.body: Customer, host, owner, office, marketer — a tailored surface for each.

steps.title: Search
steps.body: Browse listings on the map, with filters, or in AR.

steps.title: Book
steps.body: Final price computed on the server — no hidden fees.

steps.title: Pay safely
steps.body: Checkout runs through a licensed PSP. We store no card data.

steps.title: Receive settlement
steps.body: The host receives their share once verified, with an e-invoice.

cta.title: Ready to move your listings to a trusted platform?
cta.body: iOS app launching soon. Register your interest for early access.
cta.note: Sign-up channels open with the first TestFlight build.

footer.note: This site is a marketing preview. It collects no payment data.
